title: Taft Jordan and Chick Webb
summary: Taft heard him at the Harlem Opera House and they were close at the Savoy; Goines reports Taft's death.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Okay. Now, what about guys like Taft Jordan? How did they fit in?
Oh, Taft. He was with Chick Webb at the time when I met him.

When I got to New York, this was the time when I was first going into the Savoy as the second band in there, alternating with Chick. Well, Taft and myself, like the rest of Chick's men, we knew each other. And Taft used to do a lot of Louis' things.

And I, oh before, before I went into the Savoy, Taft came down to the Harlem Opera House first to see me when I was there, when I was doing "Shine", the high C's and all that stuff. And then, I met him again at the Savoy.

But, we got very close around there. Even I, when Taft took off some time, Chick came to me and Taft came and asked me would I go out with Chick for a one-night stand. You know, cause Taft had the big chair in the band.
So, I don't know where Taft is now.
Well, Taft died just in December.
You know, I thought. I'd hate, I didn't want to say that.
